caseNameFull: Moones MELLOULI, applicant v. Loretta E. LYNCH, Attorney General.

opinions.text: Application for stay presented to Justice ALITO and by him referred to the Court granted. Further proceedings in the Board of Immigration Appeals are stayed pending the timely filing of a petition for writ of certiorari, or of a petition for writ of mandamus and prohibition, and further order of this Court.
